SELECT DISTINCT 
RTC.CLM_ID AS CLAIM_ID,
CID.CID_ID AS HSN

FROM            HS.RTCLM1			AS RTC
JOIN            HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON RTC.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
JOIN			HS.INS_INSURED		AS INS	ON RTC.INS_ID = INS.INS_ID AND INS.INS_DEL_TS IS NULL
JOIN			HS.CID_CUST_ID		AS CID 	ON INS.INS_CUS_ID = CID.CID_CUS_ID AND CID.CID_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CID.CID_TYPE = 'HSN' AND CID.CID_EFF_DT = (SELECT CID_EFF_DT FROM HS.CID_CUST_ID WHERE CID.CID_CUS_ID = CID_CUS_ID AND CID_TYPE = 'HSN' AND CID_DEL_TS IS NULL ORDER BY CID_EFF_DT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR)
WITH UR
